title: Jonah and the Portrait
author: Theo Almeida
blurb: Marguerite Eriksen, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
